verdict.rationale: Supabase Realtime documents both halves of the story first-party. Presence tracks and synchronizes user state across clients, such as who's online. Broadcast sends low-latency messages between clients for cursor tracking, game events, typing indicators and similar ephemeral state. A community note that Realtime is written in Elixir adds only thin context. Missing for 10: in-depth API-level documentation (presence sync/join/leave events, channel authorization, limits) and independent hands-on corroboration of presence/broadcast behavior.
